data.one_liner: Code generator for the auto_route declarative routing solution.
data.what_it_does: Generates all the necessary routing and navigation code for the auto_route library based on your annotated widgets and route configurations.
use_when: You are using auto_route for your application's navigation
You want automated generation of route paths and parameters
avoid_when: You are not using the auto_route package
You prefer writing all navigation route configurations manually
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with the auto_route library
weaknesses: Tight dependency coupling with specific auto_route versions
data.setup_notes: Requires build_runner to run code generation alongside auto_route.

alternatives.name: go_router_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative code generation tool if you are using go_router instead of auto_route.
